newsitem.title: USA: Monarch Resources buys Mexico gold property.
newsitem.headline: Monarch Resources buys Mexico gold property.

text.p: Monarch Resources Ltd said Thursday it bought a 2,300 hectare gold property in Durango State, Mexico, in a transaction that will cost the company a minimum of $1.3 million over four years.
Under the agreement, the company must adhere to a $775,000 work committment program and pay $515,000 over four years to the property's unnamed seller.

Monarch also agreed to pay the seller either a three percent net smelter return royalty or a minimum advance royalty of $300,000, should gold be discovered on the property. The company has the option to pull out of the agreement anytime after its first year, a Monarch spokesman said.
The property is surrounded by Monarch's 60,000-hectare Saladillo claim block.
Monarch said it will begin preparations to mine the property early next year.
